categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Huaming Intelligent Terminal Equipment Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: AFC (Automatic Fare Collection) systems for urban rail transit and related fields, ETC (Electronic Toll Collection) products for intelligent transportation, and heat management systems for new energy vehicles, rail transit, and energy storage. These segments cover equipment manufacturing, system integration, and technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated computer, network, automation, IC card, and mechatronics technologies for AFC systems. ETC products utilize DSRC short-range communication technology with innovations like zero-wake-up OBU and phased array antennas. Heat management systems employ advanced liquid cooling, integrated thermal control, and intelligent sensor technologies. Production follows order-based manufacturing with a combination of in-house and outsourced processes, supported by strong R&D capabilities and patented core modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include urban rail transit operators, highway toll operators, vehicle manufacturers (notably in new energy vehicles), energy storage system integrators, and public transportation entities. The company serves major domestic cities and international markets such as India, Malaysia, Argentina, and the US. It also partners with leading vehicle manufacturers like Honda, BYD, and Geely for ETC and heat management products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant presence in major cities including Shanghai, Chongqing, and Zhengzhou. It has expanded overseas markets in Southeast Asia, South Asia, Europe, North America, and Latin America. Subsidiaries and branches are located in Beijing, Zhejiang, Guangxi, Hong Kong, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Huaming operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and system integrator. It produces core AFC terminal equipment, ETC vehicle and roadside units, and heat management systems, supplying these to system integrators, infrastructure operators, and vehicle OEMs. It also provides software and technical services, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier and technology partner within the transportation and new energy vehicle supply chains.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in AFC system innovation, ETC product upgrades including V2X and zero-wake-up technologies, and advanced heat management solutions for new energy vehicles and energy storage. It focuses on integrated, intelligent, and cost-effective products, expanding digital and smart transportation applications. R&D investments target multi-disciplinary integration, patent development, and adaptation to evolving market demands such as smart city infrastructure and vehicle electrification.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of AFC terminal equipment, ETC OBUs and RSUs, and heat management systems. Additional income comes from technical services, system integration contracts, after-sales maintenance, and performance-based compensation agreements. The company employs direct sales and bidding for public infrastructure projects, with some retail and online sales channels for ETC products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As one of the earliest and leading AFC terminal equipment manufacturers in China, the company holds a strong domestic market position with extensive project experience and international exports. In ETC, it competes with other national high-tech enterprises, leveraging patented technologies and OEM partnerships. In heat management, it competes in a growing but competitive new energy vehicle component market, emphasizing technological leadership and customer integration. The company faces industry challenges including pricing pressure and market competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 626 million, a 4.22% increase year-over-year, with segment revenues of RMB 365 million (AFC), RMB 148 million (ETC), and RMB 113 million (heat management). Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 10.75 million, with losses mainly due to ETC segment revenue and margin declines. Export sales grew significantly, accounting for 29% of revenue. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 2.1 billion and a moderate debt ratio of 30.74%, with ongoing investments in R&D and overseas expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive integration of advanced technologies, patented core modules, and strong R&D capabilities to deliver reliable, intelligent, and cost-effective AFC, ETC, and heat management solutions. Its products feature high stability, compatibility, and innovative functions such as zero-wake-up OBU and integrated thermal management. The company’s long-standing industry experience, extensive domestic and international project footprint, and close OEM partnerships provide differentiated market credibility and customer trust.
